The '''Ishanna system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Ishanna I]], [[Ishanna II]], [[S'krrr]], [[Rabaan]], and [[Ishanna V]], as well as eleven natural [[Moon/Legends|satellites]].
